title: What they said at the time

clips.q: Give Theglobe.com credit — and about $700 million — for having perfect timing.
We’re kind of in a mania here. It doesn’t make sense.
clips.who: **Tom Taulli**, Silicon Investor, to CBS MarketWatch, Nov 13, 1998[^2]

clips.q: There’s nothing innovative or singular about the company.
clips.who: **David Menlo**, IPO Financial Network, to CBS MarketWatch, Nov 13, 1998[^2]

clips.q: We are not in a position to sustain our online business operations in the long term.
clips.who: **Chuck Peck**, chief executive, Aug 3, 2001, as quoted by InternetNews[^9]
